mapper.select: SELECT md_person_post.person_id, md_person_post.post_id, p.real_name, p.person_code, p.mobile, p.email FROM md_person_post LEFT JOIN md_person p ON p.id = md_person_post.person_id WHERE md_person_post.post_id = #{postId}
SELECT p.id AS person_id, p.real_name, p.person_code, p.mobile, p.email FROM md_person p WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM md_person_post WHERE post_id = #{postId})
